rules.title: Confirms the guest’s actual booking
rules.message: The hotel’s confirmation must point to the guest’s own booking request.

rules.title: Right city and dates
rules.check: att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && att.latest('party.confirmation/1', 'counterparty').claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: The confirmed city and check-in/check-out dates must match what the guest asked for.

rules.title: Right price
rules.message: The confirmed total must equal the room price the guest paid in.

rules.title: Deal is ready to settle
rules.message: Settlement happens once the booking is confirmed or the stay is over, and never while a guest dispute is open.

rules.title: Valid settlement
rules.message: An agreed settlement splits the money between guest and hotel and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives.

rules.title: Guest left a review
rules.message: A stay settles together with the guest’s review, so every completed booking leaves a reputation record.

rules.title: Refund is due
rules.message: The automatic refund is only for a booking the hotel never confirmed by its deadline.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: This refund was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account now (such as a dispute bond), it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The automatic refund sends the room price back to the guest and closes the account.

rules.title: Release is due
rules.message: The “nobody acted” release only fires after the guest’s window to dispute has closed.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute, the release waits for the arbiter. Silence can’t override a raised flag.

rules.title: Account holds just the room price
rules.message: The release was signed in advance for exactly the room price. If anything else is in the account, it no longer fits.

rules.title: Valid release
rules.message: The release pays the room to the hotel (less the fee) and closes the account.
